title: GPU-Accelerated Direct Numerical Simulation of Non-premixed syngas/air Flame
summary: Abstract A direct numerical simulation (DNS) of the Sandia/ETH-Zurich CO/H2/N2 flame A, a turbulent non-premixed syngas/air jet flame at a Reynolds number of 16700, is presented. The computation is performed with the GPU-accelerated compres
content: Abstract A direct numerical simulation (DNS) of the Sandia/ETH-Zurich CO/H2/N2 flame A, a turbulent non-premixed syngas/air jet flame at a Reynolds number of 16700, is presented. The computation is performed with the GPU-accelerated compressible solver STREAmS-2.0 on a grid of approximately 3.43 billion points, with detailed finite-rate chemistry and mixture-averaged molecular transport, and covers a laboratory-scale domain. Since the experimental inlet velocity profile is not fully documented, the turbulent inflow is prescribed analytically and calibrated on the declared bulk velocity. The statistical profiles reproduce theexperimental data but exhibit a systematic axial shift, which is attributed to the residual uncertainty in the inflow specification; once the shift is accounted for, mean, RMS, and conditional statistics agree closely with the measurements. Every element of the setup is analytical, and the complete statistical database is provided as Supplementary Material, so that the simulation is fully reproducible and is proposed as a numerical benchmark for the validation of reacting-flow solvers and combustion models.

title: Pemberdayaan Kelompok Tani Taruna Tani Skil Di Desa Oabikase Melalui Hilirisasi Teknologi Pupuk Bokashi Berbasis Limbah Organik Lokal
source: Jurnal Altifani Penelitian dan Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat
summary: Pengabdian masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan dan keterampilan petani dan peternak di Desa Oabikase, Kecamatan Insana Barat melihat pupuk bokashi sebagai alternatif pupuk organik ramah lingkungan dan ekonomis. Pemahaman
content: Pengabdian masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan dan keterampilan petani dan peternak di Desa Oabikase, Kecamatan Insana Barat melihat pupuk bokashi sebagai alternatif pupuk organik ramah lingkungan dan ekonomis. Pemahaman tentang pupuk bokashi masih terbatas yang berisiko menurunkan kualitas tanah jangka panjang. Metode yang digunakan meliputi tiga tahap utama: (1) Sosialisasi memberikan pemahaman tentang bokashi dan manfaatnya; (2) Demonstrasi langsung pembuatan bokashi dengan memanfaatkan bahan lokal seperti kotoran ternak, sekam padi, dedak, EM4, dan molase; serta (3) Evaluasi melalui tanya jawab dan observasi lapangan. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan partisipasi aktif dan antusiasme tinggi dari peserta. Petani berhasil mempraktikkan seluruh tahapan pembuatan bokashi, dan evaluasi lanjutan membuktikan adopsi teknologi, di mana beberapa peserta telah mengaplikasikan bokashi pada tanaman pakan ternak dan hortikultura. Peningkatan keterampilan praktis, mendorong pemanfaatan sumber daya lokal untuk mengurangi biaya produksi dan limbah, serta menginisiasi peralihan menuju pertanian berkelanjutan. Disimpulkan bahwa pelatihan ini efektif dalam meningkatkan kemandirian pupuk.

title: Geopolymers as Hydrogen Storage Media
summary: Materials‐based hydrogen storage has gained attention due to the limitations of storing hydrogen as a gas or liquid. In this study, geopolymers were explored as a hydrogen storage medium for the first time by systematically varying their Si
content: Materials‐based hydrogen storage has gained attention due to the limitations of storing hydrogen as a gas or liquid. In this study, geopolymers were explored as a hydrogen storage medium for the first time by systematically varying their Si:Al:Na/K ratios and gradually introducing Ca. The hydrogen adsorption performance was evaluated at −20, +25, or +40 °C and hydrogen pressures up to 100 bar. The Ca‐free compositions exhibited better performance in comparison to the Ca‐containing ones. Furthermore, the Na‐based geopolymers could adsorb more hydrogen than the K‐based geopolymers. For the Ca‐free geopolymers, hydrogen adsorption increased with increasing Si/Al ratio and was positively correlated with specific surface area and pore volume, but negatively correlated with average pore size. The best performance was achieved with the composition Si 20 Al 1 Na 1 which had the gravimetric hydrogen adsorption capacity of 0.64 wt.% at −20 °C and 100 bar. Even though the result is below the practical target value of 6.5 wt.% as defined by the U.S. Department of Energy, geopolymers outperformed similar zeolites when comparing to the earlier literature. Additionally, the Si 20 Al 1 Na 1 composition demonstrated excellent stability over multiple adsorption/desorption cycles. The results of this study can be used to further develop geopolymers as hydrogen storage media via chemical modifications or hybrid systems.

title: Boosting Lewis Acidity in Pd/UiO‐66 via Metal Doping for Efficient Photocatalytic Semihydrogenation of Phenylacetylene
summary: ABSTRACT The selective hydrogenation of phenylacetylene to styrene remains pivotal for polymer purification but is constrained by the over‐hydrogenation tendency of conventional Pd catalysts, which arises from insufficient metal‐support int
content: ABSTRACT The selective hydrogenation of phenylacetylene to styrene remains pivotal for polymer purification but is constrained by the over‐hydrogenation tendency of conventional Pd catalysts, which arises from insufficient metal‐support interaction. We tackle this challenge by engineering Lewis acidity and Pd active sites within a UiO‐66 framework. Atomic Pd sites are stabilized on amino‐labeled UiO‐66 via a photodeposition method, and the support acidity is modulated by Nb doping (Pd/Nb‐UN). The introduction of Nb promotes the formation of isolated Pd atoms and generates additional Lewis acid sites, which enhance phenylacetylene adsorption and facilitate strong metal‐support interaction. Under light irradiation, the optimized Pd/Nb‐UN catalyst achieves 99.99% conversion and 99.99% selectivity for the semihydrogenation of phenylacetylene within 6 min, with an ultralow Pd loading of only 0.055 wt%. The turnover frequency (TOF) reaches 11494.2 mol C═C mol Pd −1 h −1 , far exceeding that of undoped or In‐doped counterparts. Mechanistic investigations reveal that the enhanced Lewis acidity facilitates substrate preactivation and H 2 dissociation, while the electron‐deficient Pd sites suppress styrene overbinding, thereby inhibiting overhydrogenation. Moreover, the Nb‐doped support improves photogenerated charge separation and extends visible‐light absorption. This work demonstrates that synergistic engineering of metal doping and single‐atom Pd sites in MOF photocatalysts provides a powerful platform for selective hydrogenation.

title: Model-based evaluation of thermal and operational strategies for methane oxidation biosystems in cold regions
source: Waste Management & Research The Journal for a Sustainable Circular Economy
summary: Methane oxidation biosystems (MOBs), engineered within landfill covers to promote microbial methane (CH₄) oxidation, offer a sustainable approach for mitigating CH₄ emissions. However, their performance in cold regions has not been systemat
content: Methane oxidation biosystems (MOBs), engineered within landfill covers to promote microbial methane (CH₄) oxidation, offer a sustainable approach for mitigating CH₄ emissions. However, their performance in cold regions has not been systematically assessed, leaving uncertainty about their effectiveness under subzero ambient temperatures. Winter operation may be improved through external heating and aeration, but the conditions warranting their use and full-scale feasibility remain uncertain. This study developed and validated GEGCSim, a numerical model coupling multicomponent gas transport, two-phase flow, CH₄ oxidation, biological and waste heat generation, and heat transfer, to evaluate cold-region MOB performance and potential interventions. Validation against laboratory and field studies confirmed GEGCSim's ability to reproduce MOBs' thermal, gas, and oxidation dynamics. Simulations showed that passive MOBs' became inactive when ambient temperatures fell below -10°C. Strategies were evaluated to improve MOBs' winter operation. Increasing the oxidation capacity improved performance but did not sustain activity at ambient temperatures near -20°C. External heating restored winter performance, although temperatures in lower layers increased above the optimal range for methanotrophs. Active aeration eliminated oxygen (O₂) limitation and achieved complete oxidation at temperatures down to -5°C. At colder temperatures, higher CH₄ loading was required to generate sufficient heat from oxidation. However, this generated excess heat that reduced MOB efficiency in summer. Seasonal CH₄ loading could help balance winter heat generation and summer overheating in active MOBs. While these simulated strategies show potential, their long-term effectiveness at full-scale landfills, practical feasibility, costs, and environmental benefits, including external energy consumption, require further evaluation.

title: Ferroelectricity and Bipolaron-Driven Optoelectronic Behavior of ε-WO3 Nanoparticles at Room Temperature
summary: Abstract A unique polymorph of tungsten trioxide, the epsilon phase (ε-WO3), has an acentric crystal structure, which suggests it may be ferroelectric in nature. Although typically stable below −43 °C in the bulk, it has been stabilized by
content: Abstract A unique polymorph of tungsten trioxide, the epsilon phase (ε-WO3), has an acentric crystal structure, which suggests it may be ferroelectric in nature. Although typically stable below −43 °C in the bulk, it has been stabilized by our group at RT and above. This study explores the ferroelectric nature and bipolaronic behavior of ε-WO3 at room temperature (RT) for the first time. Nanostructured powders synthesized by flame spray pyrolysis (FSP) are shown to exhibit ferroelectric hysteresis and dipole switching, as confirmed via butterfly-type capacitance–voltage study at 1 MHz frequency, piezo-response force microscopy (PFM), and second harmonic generation (SHG) studies. The ferroelectric dipoles of ε-WO3 respond to electro-optical stimuli by forming a bipolaron. The latter interacts with light, producing a single-layer, all-solid-state blue coloration, namely, “the ferrochromic effect”. Our results lay the groundwork for exploring further the structurally simplest ferroelectric ε-WO3 for potentially transforming the field of optoelectronics.

title: Competing Surface Dynamics of Copper Catalyst Particles during Electrochemical Carbon Dioxide Reduction
summary: Abstract Copper is a powerful catalyst for the electrochemical carbon dioxide reduction reaction (CO2RR), but it faces challenges with selectivity and stability dependent on its structural characteristics. We developed a platform that combi
content: Abstract Copper is a powerful catalyst for the electrochemical carbon dioxide reduction reaction (CO2RR), but it faces challenges with selectivity and stability dependent on its structural characteristics. We developed a platform that combines graphitized carbon nanofibers with identical-location transmission electron microscopy (IL-TEM) to study individual copper nanoparticles at the atomic scale under various reaction conditions. Notably, we observed that competing phenomena such as Ostwald ripening, coalescence, selective etching, and Coulomb-explosion-like fragmentation coexist in the same reaction area, with the latter being qualitatively consistent with a charge-driven fission pathway in larger nanoparticles (>10 nm). By tracking uniquely identifiable nanoparticles both individually and in groups, our findings focus on the range of surface-confined restructuring pathways during CO2RR. This contrasts with solution-mediated phenomena, such as dissolution–precipitation, which dominate under open-circuit potential (OCP) and significantly destabilize the catalyst prior to the reaction, highlighting the importance of eliminating this effect. Under CO2RR conditions, Cu nanoparticles are highly sensitive to subtle variations in the support’s nanotexture, defects, and electronic structure, leading to the coexistence of counteracting mechanisms we observed. These observations provide a structural framework for understanding the dynamic behavior of copper-on-carbon catalysts under CO2RR conditions, guiding the development of strategies to improve catalyst stability and performance.

title: Traversing the canopy: phenology-driven changes and within-canopy transport shape the phyllosphere microbiome in a temperate floodplain hardwood forest
summary: Phyllosphere microbiomes are subject to microbial import from various sources and undergo substantial changes during phenological changes of plants. However, especially for forest canopies, these processes are still poorly understood. We di
content: Phyllosphere microbiomes are subject to microbial import from various sources and undergo substantial changes during phenological changes of plants. However, especially for forest canopies, these processes are still poorly understood. We disentangled the controls of phenology-driven changes versus tree species identity on the phyllosphere microbiome in a temperate floodplain forest and assessed the role of transport processes in shaping distribution patterns within the canopy. Leveraging the infrastructure of the Leipzig canopy crane (Central Germany), we followed bacterial community composition and rainwater-mediated bacterial transport for oak (Quercus robur L.), ash (Fraxinus excelsior L.) and linden (Tilia cordata MILL) across early (May), mid (July) and late (October) phenological stages. These stages explained 23% of phyllosphere bacterial community variation, followed by tree species identity (13%) and canopy position (2%). Phyllosphere bacterial community assembly was mostly driven by dispersal limitation at the early phenological stage while communities became more homogeneous and functionally redundant during mid and late phenological stages, along with a strong decline of plant pathogens and increasing potential for microbially mediated biocontrol mechanisms. Throughfall-mediated transport of bacteria increased substantially from March to May, indicating the strong influence of wash-off effects from the emerging foliage. Our findings demonstrate that in temperate forests, phenology-driven effects on the phyllosphere microbiome exceed tree species' specific effects. Extent and selectivity of throughfall-mediated mobilization of microbes adds another layer of complexity to the spatial heterogeneity of microbial communities in tree crowns.

title: Frequent occurrence of newly formed aerosol particles over wide geographical areas in the Arctic free troposphere and atmospheric boundary layer
summary: New particle formation (NPF) can impact the Arctic radiative energy budget since this region is particularly sensitive to changes in aerosol particle and cloud condensation nuclei concentrations. Prior measurements have predominantly invest
content: New particle formation (NPF) can impact the Arctic radiative energy budget since this region is particularly sensitive to changes in aerosol particle and cloud condensation nuclei concentrations. Prior measurements have predominantly investigated NPF in the Arctic atmospheric boundary layer (ABL), while vertically-resolved studies on newly formed aerosol particles remain scarce. Here, we present an analysis which suggests that NPF may take place throughout the entire lower Arctic troposphere. We have reached this conclusion by analyzing aerosol particle number size distribution data collected during a springtime aircraft campaign (BACSAM II) in the vicinity of Svalbard, the Fram Strait, and northern Greenland. We detected newly formed aerosol particles over distances of hundreds of kilometers, at various altitudes ranging from about 60 to 3900 m, and identified four atmospheric scenarios for their occurrence: newly formed particles in the free troposphere, in the ABL over sea ice, in the vicinity of clouds, and in the ABL over ocean with sea ice floes. Our results indicate that regional Arctic atmospheric processes as well as long-range transport may play key roles in the formation of new particles. In particular, we deduce that one possible mechanism leading to free tropospheric NPF could be associated with warm-air intrusions.

title: ArchaeaHQ: a curated reference database of archaeal genomes
summary: Archaea have proven to be major players in biogeochemical cycles across diverse ecosystems, yet we still see an underrepresentation of archaeal genomes in the datasets used by popular computational biology tools. Here, we present ArchaeaHQ,
content: Archaea have proven to be major players in biogeochemical cycles across diverse ecosystems, yet we still see an underrepresentation of archaeal genomes in the datasets used by popular computational biology tools. Here, we present ArchaeaHQ, a quality-controlled, systematically curated reference database of 25,584 archaeal genomes compiled initially from 43,045 assemblies from all four archaeal kingdoms retrieved from NCBI: Methanobacteriati (Euryarchaeota), Thermoproteati (TACK), Nanobdellati (DPANN) and Promethearchaeati (Asgard). All genomes in the database passed standardized quality control, requiring ≥70% completeness and ≤10% contamination. A total of 44.0% of genomes in ArchaeaHQ achieved ≥90% completeness, while 92.7% exhibited ≤5% contamination. ArchaeaHQ comprises 18,701 metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs; 73.1%) and 6,883 isolate genomes (26.9%). Approximately 76% of MAGs are assigned to 17 ecologically meaningful categories based on sampling origin, and around 65% of genomes include geographic metadata. ArchaeaHQ is available at https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.32266599 for download and at https://vee-lab.eu/archaeahq for online browsing. This resource was designed to provide an analysis-ready reference set for metagenomic, biogeochemical and ecological studies, comparative genomics analyses and the development of archaeal-specific bioinformatic tools.

title: Toward Property-Directed Catalytic Skeletal Editing of Functional Organic Materials
summary: Abstract Late-stage skeletal editing has emerged as a useful strategy in synthetic and medicinal chemistry for altering molecular frameworks by atom insertion, deletion, replacement, or bond reorganization. Functional organic molecules and
content: Abstract Late-stage skeletal editing has emerged as a useful strategy in synthetic and medicinal chemistry for altering molecular frameworks by atom insertion, deletion, replacement, or bond reorganization. Functional organic molecules and materials are commonly optimized through peripheral substitution and de novo framework construction. Direct modification of an existing skeleton provides a complementary means of tuning electronic structure, molecular shape, chirality, packing, and processability. Herein we examine catalytic skeletal editing with an emphasis on functional organic materials, specifically π-conjugated molecules, dyes, polymers, and covalent frameworks. Representative examples are evaluated in terms of catalytic status and experimentally demonstrated properties. Key requirements for broader application include site selectivity, element transfer, catalyst compatibility, and control of editing extent in extended materials. The emerging opportunity is to move skeletal editing from reaction-centered diversification toward catalyst-controlled, property-directed modification.

title: Molecular mapping of an exoplanet with JWST: Detection of NH3 and HCN in the temperate super-Jupiter Epsilon Indi Ab
summary: Epsilon Indi Ab is currently the coldest and one of the closest directly imaged exoplanets (T_ eff = 275 K, d=3.6 pc). It offers a unique opportunity to test our understanding of the physical and chemical properties of gas giants across the
content: Epsilon Indi Ab is currently the coldest and one of the closest directly imaged exoplanets (T_ eff = 275 K, d=3.6 pc). It offers a unique opportunity to test our understanding of the physical and chemical properties of gas giants across the full temperature range spanned by hotter directly imaged exoplanets and the cooler giants of the Solar System. We characterize the atmosphere of Epsilon Indi Ab using infrared spectroscopic observations. We present JWST spectroscopic observations of Epsilon Indi Ab obtained with MIRI in the medium-resolution spectrograph mode (4.9--27.9 μm) and NIRSpec in the integral field unit mode (2.87--5.27 μm). The data are highly contaminated by the stellar light from the bright host star. We therefore adopted a high-pass filtering and cross-correlation approach based on atmospheric models to detect the planetary signal and specific molecules. petitRADTRANS The cross-correlation analysis enabled us to robustly detect the planet with both instruments with a signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) up to mathrm S/N =15.0. Using molecular mapping, we securely identified the presence of (maximum mathrm NH3 S/N = 14.4), (maximum mathrm H2O S/N = 11.3), (mathrm HCN S/N = 5.3) and marginally detected (mathrm PH3 S/N = 4.1), (mathrm CH4 S/N = 3.8), (mathrm C2H2 S/N = 3.9) and (mathrm CO2 S/N = 2.6). In particular, Epsilon Indi Ab becomes the coldest exoplanet in which and have been identified so far. The presence of HCN likely implies intense vertical mixing. NH3 HCN These first results confirm that infrared spectroscopy combined with cross-correlation techniques can be used to characterize the atmosphere of directly imaged exoplanets with JWST, even when the contamination by the host star is critical.

title: Unraveling Bonding Evolution in Carbon-Centered Gold(I) Clusters: Structural, Electronic, and Ligand Effects
summary: Abstract Despite recent advances in the synthesis and structural characterization of carbon-centered gold(I) clusters, the fundamental nature of their C−Au bonding and its relationship with the number of Au atoms remain elusive. Here, we re
content: Abstract Despite recent advances in the synthesis and structural characterization of carbon-centered gold(I) clusters, the fundamental nature of their C−Au bonding and its relationship with the number of Au atoms remain elusive. Here, we report a comprehensive theoretical investigation of CAuIn (n = 6, 5, 4) clusters protected by N-heterocyclic carbene and triphenylphosphine ligands, revealing a systematic evolution of the bonding architecture. Using adaptive natural density partitioning analysis, we identified the transition from classical two-center two-electron (2c−2e) C−Au bonds in the CAu4 core to delocalized three-center two-electron (3c−2e) Au−C−Au bonds specific to the CAu6 core. Notably, the CAuI5 cluster acts as a structural bridge, featuring two axial 2c−2e bonds with orbital characteristics resembling those of the 3c−2e bonds in CAuI6, together with three equatorial 2c−2e bonding environments. This study demonstrates that the relative contributions of the central carbon 2s and 2p orbitals serve as a key electronic descriptor of the nature of C−Au bonding. Furthermore, the coordinated ligands influence the structural distortion of the CAu6 core. Smaller ligands tend to favor symmetric CAu6 cores, whereas bulkier ligands are associated with greater core distortion and a preference for asymmetric CAu6 cores. Both the distortion of the CAu6 core and the chiral ligands contribute to the chirality of the entire metal cluster. This study provides an integrated bonding model that correlates the number of Au atoms in the cluster, electronic structure, ligand effects, stability, and chirality, offering valuable insights for the rational design of functionalized gold(I) nanoclusters.

title: Divergent methane production and microbial community responses to carbon enrichment in freshwater wetland sediments
summary: Abstract Methane (CH 4 ) accumulation in wetland sediments reflects interactions among organic matter, sediment chemistry, and microbial communities. We combined depth-resolved field characterization across four wetland habitats in northern
content: Abstract Methane (CH 4 ) accumulation in wetland sediments reflects interactions among organic matter, sediment chemistry, and microbial communities. We combined depth-resolved field characterization across four wetland habitats in northern Israel with complementary incubations to examine methane accumulation and responses to labile-carbon enrichment. Sediment cores were characterized using Rock-Eval analysis, porewater chemistry, oxygen profiling at three sites, and mcrA amplicon sequencing. High CH 4 concentrations occurred under contrasting conditions: Ein Nimfit (EN) contained approximately 12% total organic carbon and reached 2.1 mM CH₄, whereas Ein Afek site EA2 contained approximately 5% carbon and accumulated 0.7–1.7 mM CH 4 . Both showed sulfate depletion, but EN exhibited pronounced sulfide accumulation, whereas EA2 showed greater dissolved iron and nutrient enrichment. Their classified methanogenic assemblages also differed. EA1 remained methane poor despite increasing carbon content with depth, while EA3 combined low carbon content and CH 4 accumulation with detectable methanogens and lower methanogenic diversity. In a 36-day bottle experiments using sediments from two of the four wetland habitats, sucrose-amended EA3 exhibited a transient maximum of 18.8 mmol collected CH 4 kg⁻¹ wet sediment during Days 22–29, whereas EN reached its highest collected amount during Days 29–36. Methane proportions increased before the large output increase in EA3 but remained comparatively stable and high in EN. Soluble chemical oxygen demand trajectories and microbial community changes also differed. These findings identify distinct biogeochemical settings supporting methane accumulation and demonstrate methanogenic potential in low-CH 4 sediment, emphasizing the complementary information provided by field profiles, microbial characterization, and exploratory enrichment experiments. Importance Wetlands store carbon but also produce methane, making it important to understand why methane accumulates in some sediments and remains scarce in others. Across four habitats in northern Israel, methane-rich sediments differed in their carbon content, dissolved chemical constituents, and methane-producing archaeal communities. Conversely, carbon-rich layers and the presence of methane producers did not consistently coincide with methane accumulation. Complementary laboratory incubations showed that sediment containing little methane in the field could express substantial methane-production potential after labile carbon amendment, accompanied by changes in bacterial and archaeal communities. The study brings together sediment properties, chemical profiles, and microbial responses to distinguish the conditions associated with methane accumulation from the capacity to produce methane. This distinction helps frame future investigations of how changing carbon inputs and wetland conditions influence microbial carbon processing.

商务部等9部门关于深入推进再生资源回收体系建设 促进回收行业高质量发展的意见
商流通发2026年第206号
为深入贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，持续完善再生资源回收体系，现提出如下意见。
一、总体要求
坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，坚持市场主导与政府引导相结合、便民利民和协同共建相统一、全面推进与因地制宜相协调，加快再生资源回收体系建设，持续提升再生资源回收便利性、规范性，切实解决“扔比买难”等问题。到2030年，初步建立起回收网络健全完善、居民交投便捷顺畅、分拣环节高效先进、末端处理绿色规范的再生资源回收体系。
二、推广运用典型回收模式
（一）推行多品类综合性再生资源回收模式。倡导“两网融合”。加强生活垃圾分类与再生资源回收网点衔接融合，推动设施场地共享、作业队伍共建，促进生活垃圾中的可回收物回收后进入再生资源回收体系，实现生活垃圾减量和资源回收。发展“互联网+回收”。引导居民通过互联网平台或手机小程序等线上提交回收需求，回收企业人员按约定时间和约定价格上门回收；或由回收企业在有条件的小区设立智能回收箱，居民按操作流程自行交投再生资源。推广“以车代库”。鼓励在回收场地受限或回收网点偏远的地区设置具有收旧、暂储、运输等功能的流动回收车辆，补充发挥固定站点作用，确保即收即走或即满即走。（各地商务、住房城乡建设、交通运输主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
（二）建立完善大件废旧家具回收清运模式。探索包干清运。结合实际，在一定区域内确定一家或几家回收企业，包干负责居民家庭大件废旧家具搬运、存放以及后续回收清运。推进市场化上门清运。鼓励回收企业在综合考虑大件家具类型规格、楼层高度、有无电梯等因素基础上，提供大件废旧家具上门回收清运服务；支持回收企业加强与物业服务企业合作，开展大件废旧家具回收。支持开展公益回收清运。及时组织回收企业统一免费回收居民按约定时间投放至指定存放点的大件废旧家具。引导家具生产、销售企业定期开展“大件家具清运日”等活动，加大绿色低碳活动宣传力度。（各地商务、住房城乡建设、交通运输主管部门按职责分工负责）
（三）积极推广废旧家电回收模式。优化实施“以旧换新+回收”。支持家电销售企业联合生产企业、回收企业开展以旧换新促销活动，企业主动向消费者提供“送新收旧”一站式服务,并将回收的废家电交予有处理资格的企业处理。促进全链条合作。推动家电生产企业自建或合资建设回收、分拣、拆解、利用设施。推动废旧家电拆解企业主动加强上下游合作，有效链接家电前端回收与后端规范拆解。拓宽“公物仓”循环利用渠道。支持政府机关、企事业单位将闲置资产纳入“公物仓”调剂管理，加强与回收企业合作，对经维修可继续使用的旧电脑、空调等办公设备及家具等进行循环利用。（各地商务、机关事务管理主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
三、抓好动力电池、光伏组件、风机叶片“新三样”固废回收拆解
（四）加强废旧动力电池回收处理。修订实施《报废机动车回收管理办法实施细则》，推动新能源汽车“车电一体报废”回收拆解。研究制定新能源汽车动力电池数字身份证管理制度及相关行政法规。加强关键技术标准供给，积极推动国内成熟标准转化为国际标准。（工业和信息化、发展改革、公安、生态环境、商务主管部门及市场监管、金融监管部门按职责分工负责）
（五）发展退役光伏、废旧风机设备回收拆解。推动电力央企与综合利用企业建立市场化业务对接机制。落实废光伏组件、风机叶片等有关处置规定，鼓励发电企业建立退役设备回收体系。指导大型央企依据新能源产业分布，合理投资布局回收网络和利用基地。引导企业突破关键共性技术，推广应用人工智能等先进技术装备。制订退役风机叶片和光伏组件回收处理管理办法。（能源、发展改革、国有资产管理、生态环境、商务主管部门按职责分工负责）
四、促进回收行业提质升级
（六）加强回收网络布局。在城镇地区，以分拣中心提升改造为重点，支持建设一批绿色化、智能化、专业化分拣中心，完善回收站点、中转站、分拣中心三级回收体系。在农村地区，进一步发挥县域商业体系和供销合作社再生资源回收利用网络体系作用，推动实现回收网络全覆盖。引导企业规范建设运营，赋能前端个体经营者等零散回收队伍，提供规范化、便利化的回收服务，加强环境卫生管理。严禁未取得废弃电器电子产品处理资格的经营主体擅自从事废弃电器电子产品处理业务。（各地商务、生态环境主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
（七）提升回收数智化水平。充分运用大数据、云计算、人工智能等信息技术，提升再生资源回收行业数字化、智能化发展水平。鼓励再生资源回收体系建设试点城市开发应用再生资源回收信息平台，便于居民查询、交售和企业供需对接。鼓励有条件的回收企业建设再生资源回收信息化综合服务平台，提供再生资源增值服务，完善再生资源数据分析归集功能。（各地商务、发展改革主管部门按职责分工负责）
五、推动完善回收体系
（八）压实地方主体责任。地方各级人民政府商务主管部门牵头，相关部门分工协作履行行业管理职责，因地制宜运用典型回收模式，共同抓好再生资源回收重点任务。坚持激励与约束并重，督促各级干部担当作为，对存在工作不力等严重问题的，依规依纪严肃通报和追责问责。培育一批规范化、规模化回收企业。一视同仁支持各类所有制经营主体在回收体系建设中发挥作用，不得排除民营企业、中小企业、个体工商户参与。（各地商务、国有资产管理主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
（九）落实生产者责任延伸制度。引导生产企业将回收理念贯穿设计、研发、生产、销售全过程，以自建或委托等方式建立与产品销售量相匹配的废旧产品回收体系。开展低碳节约生态设计，优先选择无毒无害、易于降解或便于回收利用方案。在生产过程中使用便于回收处理的技术工艺。（各地发展改革、商务主管部门按职责分工负责）
（十）优化销售企业回收服务。支持家电销售企业开展以旧换新促销活动，激发居民交旧购新积极性。引导家具销售企业发挥产销衔接、商品集散的渠道优势，持续优化服务能力，提供废旧家具“送新拖旧”回收服务。（各地商务主管部门负责）
（十一）提升回收企业专业化水平。在有条件的地方，鼓励生产、销售、回收、利用企业深化全链条合作，共同落实社会责任。推动专业化、规范化回收企业进街道、进社区、进乡村，不断提高服务水平。（各地商务主管部门负责）
（十二）鼓励相关单位发挥作用。支持相关协会等通过智慧社区服务平台等方式，公布大件废弃物存放点或再生资源回收点信息，引导居民规范交投再生资源。物业服务企业可以根据业主需求，为回收人员和车辆进出小区提供便利。（各地商务、住房城乡建设主管部门按职责分工负责）
六、强化工作协同
（十三）加强要素保障。充分考虑回收基础设施用地需要，加大土地保障力度。在居民小区设置大件废弃物存放点，方便居民交投、周转。保障回收运营车辆合理路权，依法依规落实好“反向开票”等相关政策，探索在再生资源回收行业开展产品碳足迹核算。深入推进城市一刻钟便民生活圈建设，补齐社区网点短板，将再生资源回收纳入基本保障类便民服务范围。（商务、发展改革、公安、生态环境主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
（十四）强化执法监督。加大再生资源回收利用环节环境监管和执法力度。加强对再生资源回收行业从业人员劳动保护，坚决防范安全生产隐患。加强回收站点环境卫生管理，强化回收行业市场秩序监督管理，依法查处再生资源回收领域有关违法行为，严厉打击有关犯罪行为。（商务、公安、生态环境主管部门及市场监管部门按职责分工负责）
（十五）健全法规标准体系。加快再生资源回收法规建设，支持各地加强再生资源回收体系立法。完善再生资源回收标准体系，按照有关规定给予再生资源回收统计必要支持。（商务、生态环境主管部门及市场监管部门按职责分工负责）
（十六）深入开展试点。商务部建立再生资源回收体系建设工作机制，持续深入推进再生资源回收体系建设试点城市和试点企业相关工作，将“新三样”固废回收利用等一并纳入，推广一批典型模式和经验做法。探索完善再生资源回收重点联系企业制度。（商务、工业和信息化、能源、国有资产管理主管部门按职责分工负责）

坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，坚持市场主导与政府引导相结合、便民利民和协同共建相统一、全面推进与因地制宜相协调，加快再生资源回收体系建设，持续提升再生资源回收便利性、规范性，切实解决“扔比买难”等问题。到2030年，初步建立起回收网络健全完善、居民交投便捷顺畅、分拣环节高效先进、末端处理绿色规范的再生资源回收体系。
二、推广运用典型回收模式
（一）推行多品类综合性再生资源回收模式。倡导“两网融合”。加强生活垃圾分类与再生资源回收网点衔接融合，推动设施场地共享、作业队伍共建，促进生活垃圾中的可回收物回收后进入再生资源回收体系，实现生活垃圾减量和资源回收。发展“互联网+回收”。引导居民通过互联网平台或手机小程序等线上提交回收需求，回收企业人员按约定时间和约定价格上门回收；或由回收企业在有条件的小区设立智能回收箱，居民按操作流程自行交投再生资源。推广“以车代库”。鼓励在回收场地受限或回收网点偏远的地区设置具有收旧、暂储、运输等功能的流动回收车辆，补充发挥固定站点作用，确保即收即走或即满即走。（各地商务、住房城乡建设、交通运输主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
（二）建立完善大件废旧家具回收清运模式。探索包干清运。结合实际，在一定区域内确定一家或几家回收企业，包干负责居民家庭大件废旧家具搬运、存放以及后续回收清运。推进市场化上门清运。鼓励回收企业在综合考虑大件家具类型规格、楼层高度、有无电梯等因素基础上，提供大件废旧家具上门回收清运服务；支持回收企业加强与物业服务企业合作，开展大件废旧家具回收。支持开展公益回收清运。及时组织回收企业统一免费回收居民按约定时间投放至指定存放点的大件废旧家具。引导家具生产、销售企业定期开展“大件家具清运日”等活动，加大绿色低碳活动宣传力度。（各地商务、住房城乡建设、交通运输主管部门按职责分工负责）
（三）积极推广废旧家电回收模式。优化实施“以旧换新+回收”。支持家电销售企业联合生产企业、回收企业开展以旧换新促销活动，企业主动向消费者提供“送新收旧”一站式服务,并将回收的废家电交予有处理资格的企业处理。促进全链条合作。推动家电生产企业自建或合资建设回收、分拣、拆解、利用设施。推动废旧家电拆解企业主动加强上下游合作，有效链接家电前端回收与后端规范拆解。拓宽“公物仓”循环利用渠道。支持政府机关、企事业单位将闲置资产纳入“公物仓”调剂管理，加强与回收企业合作，对经维修可继续使用的旧电脑、空调等办公设备及家具等进行循环利用。（各地商务、机关事务管理主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
三、抓好动力电池、光伏组件、风机叶片“新三样”固废回收拆解
（四）加强废旧动力电池回收处理。修订实施《报废机动车回收管理办法实施细则》，推动新能源汽车“车电一体报废”回收拆解。研究制定新能源汽车动力电池数字身份证管理制度及相关行政法规。加强关键技术标准供给，积极推动国内成熟标准转化为国际标准。（工业和信息化、发展改革、公安、生态环境、商务主管部门及市场监管、金融监管部门按职责分工负责）
（五）发展退役光伏、废旧风机设备回收拆解。推动电力央企与综合利用企业建立市场化业务对接机制。落实废光伏组件、风机叶片等有关处置规定，鼓励发电企业建立退役设备回收体系。指导大型央企依据新能源产业分布，合理投资布局回收网络和利用基地。引导企业突破关键共性技术，推广应用人工智能等先进技术装备。制订退役风机叶片和光伏组件回收处理管理办法。（能源、发展改革、国有资产管理、生态环境、商务主管部门按职责分工负责）
四、促进回收行业提质升级
（六）加强回收网络布局。在城镇地区，以分拣中心提升改造为重点，支持建设一批绿色化、智能化、专业化分拣中心，完善回收站点、中转站、分拣中心三级回收体系。在农村地区，进一步发挥县域商业体系和供销合作社再生资源回收利用网络体系作用，推动实现回收网络全覆盖。引导企业规范建设运营，赋能前端个体经营者等零散回收队伍，提供规范化、便利化的回收服务，加强环境卫生管理。严禁未取得废弃电器电子产品处理资格的经营主体擅自从事废弃电器电子产品处理业务。（各地商务、生态环境主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
（七）提升回收数智化水平。充分运用大数据、云计算、人工智能等信息技术，提升再生资源回收行业数字化、智能化发展水平。鼓励再生资源回收体系建设试点城市开发应用再生资源回收信息平台，便于居民查询、交售和企业供需对接。鼓励有条件的回收企业建设再生资源回收信息化综合服务平台，提供再生资源增值服务，完善再生资源数据分析归集功能。（各地商务、发展改革主管部门按职责分工负责）
五、推动完善回收体系
（八）压实地方主体责任。地方各级人民政府商务主管部门牵头，相关部门分工协作履行行业管理职责，因地制宜运用典型回收模式，共同抓好再生资源回收重点任务。坚持激励与约束并重，督促各级干部担当作为，对存在工作不力等严重问题的，依规依纪严肃通报和追责问责。培育一批规范化、规模化回收企业。一视同仁支持各类所有制经营主体在回收体系建设中发挥作用，不得排除民营企业、中小企业、个体工商户参与。（各地商务、国有资产管理主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
（九）落实生产者责任延伸制度。引导生产企业将回收理念贯穿设计、研发、生产、销售全过程，以自建或委托等方式建立与产品销售量相匹配的废旧产品回收体系。开展低碳节约生态设计，优先选择无毒无害、易于降解或便于回收利用方案。在生产过程中使用便于回收处理的技术工艺。（各地发展改革、商务主管部门按职责分工负责）
（十）优化销售企业回收服务。支持家电销售企业开展以旧换新促销活动，激发居民交旧购新积极性。引导家具销售企业发挥产销衔接、商品集散的渠道优势，持续优化服务能力，提供废旧家具“送新拖旧”回收服务。（各地商务主管部门负责）
（十一）提升回收企业专业化水平。在有条件的地方，鼓励生产、销售、回收、利用企业深化全链条合作，共同落实社会责任。推动专业化、规范化回收企业进街道、进社区、进乡村，不断提高服务水平。（各地商务主管部门负责）
（十二）鼓励相关单位发挥作用。支持相关协会等通过智慧社区服务平台等方式，公布大件废弃物存放点或再生资源回收点信息，引导居民规范交投再生资源。物业服务企业可以根据业主需求，为回收人员和车辆进出小区提供便利。（各地商务、住房城乡建设主管部门按职责分工负责）
六、强化工作协同
（十三）加强要素保障。充分考虑回收基础设施用地需要，加大土地保障力度。在居民小区设置大件废弃物存放点，方便居民交投、周转。保障回收运营车辆合理路权，依法依规落实好“反向开票”等相关政策，探索在再生资源回收行业开展产品碳足迹核算。深入推进城市一刻钟便民生活圈建设，补齐社区网点短板，将再生资源回收纳入基本保障类便民服务范围。（商务、发展改革、公安、生态环境主管部门、供销合作社按职责分工负责）
（十四）强化执法监督。加大再生资源回收利用环节环境监管和执法力度。加强对再生资源回收行业从业人员劳动保护，坚决防范安全生产隐患。加强回收站点环境卫生管理，强化回收行业市场秩序监督管理，依法查处再生资源回收领域有关违法行为，严厉打击有关犯罪行为。（商务、公安、生态环境主管部门及市场监管部门按职责分工负责）
（十五）健全法规标准体系。加快再生资源回收法规建设，支持各地加强再生资源回收体系立法。完善再生资源回收标准体系，按照有关规定给予再生资源回收统计必要支持。（商务、生态环境主管部门及市场监管部门按职责分工负责）
（十六）深入开展试点。商务部建立再生资源回收体系建设工作机制，持续深入推进再生资源回收体系建设试点城市和试点企业相关工作，将“新三样”固废回收利用等一并纳入，推广一批典型模式和经验做法。探索完善再生资源回收重点联系企业制度。（商务、工业和信息化、能源、国有资产管理主管部门按职责分工负责）

content:
促进回收行业高质量发展——多部门详解深入推进再生资源回收体系建设
2026-11-17 21:54
字号：默认
新华社北京11月17日电 题：促进回收行业高质量发展——多部门详解深入推进再生资源回收体系建设
新华社记者黄韬铭、谢希瑶
商务部、国家发展改革委、工业和信息化部等9部门近日印发的《关于深入推进再生资源回收体系建设 促进回收行业高质量发展的意见》，11月17日对外发布。国务院新闻办公室当日举行发布会，相关部门负责人对此进行详解。
切实解决废旧家具“扔比买难”等问题
“近年来，商务部持续加大再生资源回收行业政策支持，确定了32个回收体系试点城市和78家试点企业。”商务部部长助理袁晓明说，但我国再生资源回收行业长期依赖粗放式经营，多数地区在一定程度上存在回收模式不够清晰、责任主体不够明确等问题。
大件废旧家具“扔比买难”，如何解决？意见提出探索建立包干清运、市场化上门清运、公益回收清运模式。
“包干清运，就是由地方人民政府在一定区域范围内确定一家或多家回收企业，承担起大件废旧家具回收清运责任；市场化上门清运，主要是鼓励回收企业与物业公司合作开展上门回收，在社区居民家门口构建起高效便捷的服务网络；公益回收清运，是由地方人民政府组织回收企业在约定时间内，统一免费回收居民投放的大件废旧家具，确保大件废旧家具‘清得走、有去处’。”袁晓明说。
新家电来了，废旧家电往哪儿送？
“在回收环节，我们鼓励系统再生资源回收利用企业与商贸流通企业对接合作，开展‘换新+回收’业务，促进家电换新与回收的有效衔接”。全国供销合作总社新闻发言人、经济发展与改革部部长马继红说，同时，探索建立多元化回收机制，积极发展“互联网+”回收模式，比如湖北省供销合作社搭建“以旧换新公共服务平台”，为居民提供价格评估、下单结算、上门取件等全流程服务，实现废旧家电“一键回收”。
抓好“新三样”固废回收利用
“当前，我国新能源汽车动力电池正在进入规模化退役阶段，光伏组件和风机叶片也将相继迎来退役高峰期。”袁晓明说，近年来“新三样”固废回收利用体系初具规模，但回收利用工作偏向“末端治理”，从生产端到利用端的工作链条还有断点，相关技术尚不成熟。
为此，意见对“新三样”固废回收利用作出总体部署，具体可概括为三个方面：
一是动力电池“全品类收”。修订新能源汽车废旧动力电池综合利用规范条件，推动新能源汽车“车电一体报废”回收拆解。加快补齐非车载动力型以及储能型、消费型电池回收体系短板，推动各类动力电池“退役有踪、回收有序”。
二是风光设备“全周期管”。健全回收机制，落实废旧光伏组件、风机叶片处置规定，鼓励发电企业建立退役设备回收体系；推动市场对接，研究推动电力央企与综合利用企业建立市场化业务对接机制。
三是投资布局与技术研发“全面加力”。指导大型央企依据新能源产业分布合理投资布局回收网络和利用基地，进一步优化网络布局。引导重点企业突破关键共性技术，推广应用人工智能等先进技术装备，让退役设备“收得回、拆得好”。
促进回收行业高质量发展
“根据相关协会数据，2025年全国主要品种回收总量达到4.17亿吨、同比增长4.1%，回收总额1.39万亿元、同比增长3.8%，行业总体保持稳定增长态势。”商务部流通业发展司司长李佳路说，但是目前回收网络覆盖不全、经营主体高度分散、行业“小散弱”等问题尚未得到根本改变。
为此，意见从完善回收网络、育强回收主体、强化数智赋能等方面着力，推动行业高质量发展。
“我们将指导地方完善‘回收站点—中转站—分拣中心’三级网络体系，支持中国资源循环集团、中国再生资源开发集团等大型企业与地方重点回收企业协同布局，同时支持大型回收企业提升组织化、规模化水平，培育形成一批回收行业龙头企业，发挥引领带动和兜底保障作用。”李佳路说。
“在回收站点布局建设上，我们将努力提升回收服务覆盖面。在回收模式方面，将会同有关部门加强生活垃圾分类清运体系与再生资源回收体系网点的功能衔接。”马继红表示。

content:
商务部国际司负责人就中国—东盟自贸区3.0版升级议定书生效实施答记者问
2026-11-17 10:59
商务部网站
字号：默认
问：请介绍中国—东盟自贸区3.0版升级议定书生效实施的有关情况？
答：11月16日，在菲律宾马尼拉举办的中国—东盟领导人会议上，双方领导人共同宣布中国—东盟自贸区3.0版升级议定书将于2026年12月1日正式生效实施。商务部正会同相关部门与东盟方密切沟通，做好升级议定书生效实施相关准备工作。升级议定书中英文本已经在中国自由贸易区服务网上公布，供公众查询参考，建议相关企业积极研究议定书相关内容和规则，充分把握与东盟贸易投资合作的新机遇。
问：中国—东盟自贸区目前建设情况如何？取得了哪些成效？
答：2002年，中国与东盟十国领导人宣布开启自贸区建设进程。2010年中国—东盟自贸区1.0版全面建成，双方对总体超过90%的产品实施零关税。2015年，2.0版升级议定书签署，并于2019年全面生效实施，进一步扩大服务投资开放，提升贸易便利化水平。2021年11月，习近平主席在中国—东盟建立对话关系30周年纪念峰会上提出，尽早启动中国—东盟自贸区3.0版建设，东盟方积极响应。2022年11月，双方启动3.0版升级谈判，并于2025年5月全面完成。2025年10月，双方正式签署3.0版升级议定书，中国—东盟自贸合作拓展至数字、绿色、标准、产供链等新兴领域。
可以说，中国—东盟自贸区3.0版在1.0版和2.0版传统贸易投资自由化便利化基础上，实现了从“市场开放”到“制度共建”的重要升级，中国—东盟自贸区建设进入了规则标准融合的新阶段。
随着中国—东盟自贸区建设不断深化，中国已连续17年保持东盟第一大贸易伙伴，东盟连续6年成为中国第一大贸易伙伴。2025年双方贸易额突破1万亿美元，比2002年中国—东盟自贸区建设之初增长了18倍。中国—东盟自贸区为促进双方经贸合作发挥了重要作用，成为中国与周边国家合作发展、互利共赢的典范。
问：中国—东盟自贸区3.0版升级议定书生效实施有什么重要意义？
答：升级议定书的生效实施是落实习近平主席与东盟领导人在中国—东盟建立对话关系30周年纪念峰会上达成重要共识的标志性成果，也是落实“十五五”规划纲要关于扩大高水平对外开放、开创合作共赢新局面的重大举措，充分体现了中国与东盟坚定支持多边主义和自由贸易的共同承诺。其意义不仅在于深化和拓展双边合作，更在于以开放合作应对全球挑战，为双方及世界各国企业创造丰富的市场和产业合作机遇，为亚太经济一体化注入新动能，给区域乃至全球经济增长带来更大信心。
升级议定书生效实施是国际经贸新形势下开展互利合作的成功实践。升级议定书将进一步推动中国与东盟经贸合作从“要素流动”向“规则协同”跃升，构建全方位、高质量、可持续的合作格局，体现了互利共赢、共同发展的鲜明特点。中国—东盟自贸区实现3.0版升级，将在不确定的全球经贸环境中，为所有区域内企业打造更加开放、便利、安全、稳定和可预期的区域大市场和产业链供应链体系，是以区域合作应对全球挑战的实践范例。
问：中国—东盟自贸区3.0版升级议定书生效实施将给企业带来哪些新机遇？
答：升级议定书既包括贸易便利化等“边境上”措施，也涵盖数字、绿色、标准、供应链等“边境后”新兴领域，将为双方企业进一步深入挖掘贸易投资合作潜力提供更多新机遇。
在数字经济领域，双方建立了目前各自缔约实践中最高水平的经贸规则体系及合作安排，将为促进区域数字经济发展创造良好政策环境。双方不仅将在物流、数字基础设施等“硬联通”领域开展互联互通合作，还将加强单一窗口、电子发票、电子支付、电子提单等“软联通”合作，提高系统兼容性，降低企业成本，并涵盖人工智能等新兴领域合作，力求贴合市场与企业发展需求。加强数字经济合作，有利于推动构建开放、安全、稳定、可预期的中国东盟数字贸易和投资合作环境，赋能近21亿人口的区域大市场和产业链供应链，给企业带来巨大商机。
在绿色经济领域，双方以全球发展倡议目标原则为引领，建立了自贸区项下的全面合作框架，并确立了绿色贸易、绿色投资、循环经济、可持续金融、绿色技术、绿色标准、可持续能源、数字化绿色化协同发展8大优先领域，贯穿研发、融资、生产、消费、回收全链条，积极打造区域经济绿色引擎、促进高质量发展。未来双方将在上述框架下，共同推动加强新能源汽车、光伏等重点领域合作，力争取得实质性成果，让企业和民众从区域经济绿色化发展中更多受益。
在标准和技术法规与合格评定程序领域，双方首次明确在制定自身标准时，如果没有可供参考的国际标准，可考虑参考对方标准，鼓励承认彼此合格评定结果，联合制定合格评定程序，并提出新能源汽车、电子电器等优先合作领域。加强标准合作，将有利于减少企业在区域内不同国家进行重复检测和认证的成本和时间，让产品更加顺畅高效地进入区域市场。对于企业来说，这比单纯关税优惠更有利于提升产品的竞争力。
在供应链互联互通领域，双方首次在自贸协定中纳入供应链合作单独章节，并共同作出高水平承诺。双方将共同促进关键产品和服务自由流通，利用数字技术进一步提升贸易便利化水平，增强区域供应链韧性和联通性。同时，强化基础设施互联互通，鼓励通过开展多式联运、促进可持续口岸发展、提升口岸生产力和效率等助力解决物流和交通瓶颈问题，便利双方产品和服务流通。当前中国与东盟产业链供应链合作正朝着覆盖上中下游全链条深度融合的方向发展。随着升级议定书的实施，双方企业充分发挥各自优势、实现协同发展将迎来更广阔空间。
在海关程序和贸易便利化领域，双方将利用数字化技术进一步提高贸易便利化水平。同时，加强“智慧海关”合作，提升海关监管的智能化、数字化水平，简化通关程序，减少通关时间。以智慧口岸为例，口岸通关可实现24小时“不打烊”“零等待”，极大提升通关效率。企业提前上传电子报关单、电子发票、检疫证明等单证，系统自动与主管部门共享，实现“一次提交、一次查验、一次放行”。数字化智能化的发展将为中国与东盟推进贸易便利化合作创造更多新的可能，给企业带来实实在在高效便利的感受。
此外，在竞争和消费者保护领域，双方将致力于打造公平有序的区域市场环境；在中小微企业领域，双方将支持中小企业更好融入区域价值链；在卫生与植物卫生措施领域，双方将进一步加强信息交流与技术合作，提升法律法规及政策透明度。总体来说，升级议定书不直接涉及市场准入优惠，但着眼于推动更深层次的区域内规则标准协同，目的是通过制度性安排让企业对区域市场更有信心，产业发展环境更有确定性。
问：商务部对做好中国—东盟自贸区3.0版升级议定书实施工作有哪些考虑？
答：一方面，我们将支持各地方和产业界立足自身实际，多措并举为企业做好服务，组织开展有针对性的宣介培训，帮助企业更好了解中国—东盟自贸区的新规则新安排，主动研究和挖掘升级议定书带来的新机遇，力争实现新发展。另一方面，我们将会同东盟方充分发挥中国—东盟自贸区联委会机制作用，按照升级议定书规定成立数字、绿色、标准、中小企业等相应分委会，积极推动各领域务实合作。同时，根据升级议定书中的未来工作计划，积极开展有关条款审议，并就数字经济、人工智能等领域进一步开展磋商合作，争取取得更多务实成果。

content: Maailma muuttuu jatkuvasti. Näin ollen erilaisten muutosten ennakointi, muutosten moninaisten vaikutusten tunnistaminen ja etenkin uusiin työn ja yrittäjyyden mahdollisuuksiin tarttuminen ovat hyvin keskeisiä maaseutualueiden elinvoiman säilyttämisen ja vahvistamisen näkökulmasta. Ennakointityössä erilaisten tulevaisuuden skenaarioiden luominen ja niiden toteutumisen vaikutusten arviointi tukevat päätöksentekoa, jotta epäsuotuisiin muutoksiin osataan varautua ja puuttua, mutta ennen kaikkea, jotta erilaisiin mahdollisuuksiin huomataan tarttua. Tämän raportin tarkoituksena on tukea maaseutualueita kehittävää suunnittelua ja päätöksentekoa tarjoamalla tietoa esitetyistä tulevaisuuden skenaarioista ja niiden aluetaloudellisista vaikutuksista. Tavoitteena on koota ja levittää ennakointitietoa päättäjille eri aluetasoilla. Lisäksi tavoitteena on tukea skenaario- ja arviointityötä ehdottamalla aiheita, joiden vaihtoehtoisia tulevaisuuksia ja aluetalousvaikutuksia olisi tarpeen tarkastella. Raportti on osa maaseutupolitiikan TUUMA27-verkoston toimintaa. Hyvin tehdyt skenaariot luovat monipuolista kuvaa tulevista kehityspoluista ja tarjoavat samalla vahvat lähtökohdat tulevien muutosten vaikutusten arvioinnille. Viime vuosina julkaistut skenaario- ja aluetalousjulkaisut ovat nostaneet esiin lukuisia eri toimialoille kohdistuvia työn ja yrittäjyyden mahdollisuuksia. Mahdollisuuksien taustalta löytyy erilaisia ajureita kuten ilmastonmuutos, teknologinen kehitys sekä muutokset säädösympäristössä. Tällaisten muutosten myötä muuttuvat myös tuotteiden ja palveluiden kysyntä sekä kilpailuasetelmat yritysten välillä. Kumpikin reitti kannustaa yrityksiä kehittämään toimintaansa, jolloin avautuu mahdollisuuksia myös uusille ratkaisuille ja toimijoille. Vertailemalla toteutettuja skenaario- ja aluetalousjulkaisuja keskenään havaittiin useita tulevaisuudenkuvia ja uusia mahdollisuuksia, joiden aluetalousvaikutusten arviointi olisi tarpeen päätöksenteon tueksi. Vaikutusarvioinnit auttavat päätöksentekijöitä hahmottamaan muutosten aiheuttamien laajempien talousvaikutusten suuruusluokkia ja vaikutuskanavia. Monet suunnitelluista merkittävistä investoinneista kuten uusiutuvan energian tuotantolaitoksista ja datakeskuksista sijoittuvat maaseutualueille. Lisäksi esimerkiksi ilmastonmuutokseen ja biodiversiteettiin liittyvät politiikat vaikuttavat olennaisesti maaseuduilla toteutettavaan taloudelliseen toimintaan. title: Light-activated recombination centers and negative photoconductivity in CdZnO devices
summary: Degenerate transparent conducting oxides with anomalous photoresponse offer promising avenues for advanced applications such as on-chip photonics, information processing, all-optical encryption, and advanced photodetectors. This work explor
content: Degenerate transparent conducting oxides with anomalous photoresponse offer promising avenues for advanced applications such as on-chip photonics, information processing, all-optical encryption, and advanced photodetectors. This work explores the negative photoconductivity (NPC) in nanocrystalline, n-type degenerate Cd 0.9 Zn 0.1 O thin films synthesized via a cost-effective spray pyrolysis route onto glass substrates. The NPC was tackled by studying its dependence on photoexcitation intensity for a wide – both subgap and supragap – wavelength range (365-850 nm), including exposure to different controlled atmospheres (synthetic dry air, atmospheric air, Ar, N 2 , O 2 , and CO 2 ). The activation of NPC occurred for photon energies lower than the optical bandgap, which, due to the Moss-Burstein effect, was blueshifted with respect to the intrinsic bandgap. In addition, the behavior of NPC exhibited a linear increase as the photon flux increased, while a correlation between NPC and dark conductivity is associated with exposure to increasingly oxidizing atmospheres. Surprisingly, a positive persistent photoconductivity (PPC) replaces the NPC just after the interruption of illumination. This positive PPC was very small for subgap excitation but strongly enhanced for photon energies well above the optical bandgap, also correlating linearly with the intensity of optical excitation. The NPC behavior could be understood in terms of a light-activated recombination center involving subgap photoexcitation of majority carriers from deep defect levels, while the competing positive PPC was associated with electron–hole pair generation dominating for supragap photon excitation. These findings elucidate the defect-driven carrier dynamics in Cd-based oxides and highlight their potential for wavelength-selective and atmosphere-sensitive optoelectronic devices.

title: Multi-agent game-theoretic analysis of offshore wind-to-hydrogen supply chains in China
summary: Offshore wind-to-hydrogen production is one of the key technologies for China to achieve deep decarbonization. The various stakeholders within the offshore wind-to-hydrogen production chain (wind power companies, hydrogen producers, and gov
content: Offshore wind-to-hydrogen production is one of the key technologies for China to achieve deep decarbonization. The various stakeholders within the offshore wind-to-hydrogen production chain (wind power companies, hydrogen producers, and government policymakers) form a highly complex multi-stakeholder collaborative system. The strategic interactions among stakeholders in industrial chains serve as a crucial endogenous driver of industrial evolution. This study focuses on comparing these interactions within a common offshore wind-to-hydrogen policy scenario. Consequently, four market structures were developed to model the strategic interactions among these actors: Social Planner (SP), Wind-Led (WL), Hydrogen-Led (HL), and Nash games. By establishing a mathematical programming (MPEC) framework with equilibrium constraints and a Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) game model, this study analyzes the investment scale, market competition, and social welfare outcomes across these four market structures. Results indicate that pure commercial incentives yield weak investment at the baseline zero carbon premium, with near-zero Nash capacity. Under the WL structure, the annual required-revenue guarantee links the leader’s return objective to annual costs, inducing capacity over-allocation and negative social welfare. In the baseline simulation, when carbon price, when the carbon price reaches 57.14 USD/t, the Nash structure overcomes the coordination dilemma, entering a region of rapid capacity expansion toward the WL configuration. Conversely, the HL structure illustrates how downstream leadership can limit upstream investment and system output. Furthermore, the reduction in wind power capital expenditures (CAPEX) exerts a greater leverage effect on subsidy elimination than the decline in electrolyzer costs, resulting in an asymmetric decline pattern for subsidy decoupling. Consequently, policy frameworks could consider an asymmetric incentive principle targeting upstream technologies, replace uniform subsidies with cost-coordinate-based phase-out mechanisms, and integrate anti-monopoly regulation with carbon tax recycling. This facilitates the transition across policy incubation, carbon price convergence, and commercial parity. This study provides a quantitative basis for optimizing stage-specific regulatory policies and establishes a theoretical framework to guide the structural evolution and commercialization of the offshore wind-to-hydrogen industry.

title: Structural maturation and phase transformations of ferri-oxyhydroxide precipitates for improved dewatering behaviour
summary: Acid Mine Drainage (AMD) and other mine impacted iron rich wastewater streams can negatively affect water quality. Lime treatment remains the most applied iron removal technology, but generates a voluminous, poorly dewaterable sludge domina
content: Acid Mine Drainage (AMD) and other mine impacted iron rich wastewater streams can negatively affect water quality. Lime treatment remains the most applied iron removal technology, but generates a voluminous, poorly dewaterable sludge dominated by Ferri-Oxyhydroxide (Fe-O-OH) species and gypsum, creating long-term disposal challenges. Improved dewatering characteristics were previously observed from the accelerated maturation of a freshly precipitated Fe-O-OH material cured at elevated temperatures. This study explores the time dependent maturation process progression of a Fe-O-OH precipitate at 40 °C and evaluates dewatering characteristics of the aged precipitates. Four distinct maturation process periods were identified but maturing to approximately 8 h saw the temporary emergence of a brief optimum period where dewatering improved with maximum settling and filtration rates of 1.35 ± 0.05 mm min −1 and 4.55 ± 0.08 cm 3 cm −2 min −1 being achieved, respectively. This was attributed to a more crystalline precipitate mixture made up of bigger, denser, neutrally charged particles with different morphologies and crystal habits. Further mechanism tests revealed the onset of mineral phase transformation, via a schwertmannite dissolution and reprecipitation of a goethite crystalline superstructure. Longer maturation yields the dominance of nanostructures with the associated poor dewatering behaviour. The maturation process revealed multiple competing and convoluted mechanisms that produced a novel brief optimum window with enhanced dewatering behaviour. The 8-h optimum aligns well with conventional single shifts and can be applied to an industrial setup.

title: Development potential and Energy–Water–Land Nexus of floating photovoltaics in China under the carbon neutrality framework
summary: With the intensification of climate change, achieving carbon neutrality and decarbonizing the global energy system have become pressing priorities worldwide. Floating photovoltaic (FPV) systems show a distinct synergy among clean energy pro
content: With the intensification of climate change, achieving carbon neutrality and decarbonizing the global energy system have become pressing priorities worldwide. Floating photovoltaic (FPV) systems show a distinct synergy among clean energy production, decreasing water evaporation, and improving land use efficiency, which makes them of great value for realizing the transformation of new energy power systems. Here, based on water bodies, realistic climate datasets, electric power system model and a comprehensive optimization framework aligned with China’s 2060 carbon neutrality target. A power system planning and optimization model is improved, and the development potential of FPV systems is simulated. The practical installation capacity of FPV systems with 30% surface coverage across 7,219 water bodies is estimated at 398 GW. Results show that 80% of the sites distribute in eastern and central regions (3255 water bodies). In addition, FPV system’s annual power generation is 771 TWh. The evaporation saving by FPV system is 5.7 × 10 9 km 3 annually. FPV systems can saved 59,632 km terrestrial land area and 11,939 km 2 of offshore wind power construction. FPV systems are beneficial for power infrastructure constructions, including a 45% reduction in inter-regional transmission capacity, a 26% decrease in PV grid-connection distance, and a 22% reduction in energy storage capacity. The findings suggest that FPV’s potential in regions facing water scarcity and land shortages, highlight the synergistic benefits of FPV systems in clean energy generation, water resource conservation, and land conservation.

title: Forest carbon farming across a northern European gradient: land-system archetypes for monitoring, reporting and verification, governance and implementation
summary: Forest carbon farming is increasingly promoted as a complement to emissions reductions, but its feasibility and integrity depend on ecological baseline, land-use opportunity space, governance capacity and monitoring–reporting–verification (
content: Forest carbon farming is increasingly promoted as a complement to emissions reductions, but its feasibility and integrity depend on ecological baseline, land-use opportunity space, governance capacity and monitoring–reporting–verification (MRV) maturity. This comparative scoping review synthesizes evidence from Finland, Ireland and Iceland as three contrasting northern land-system archetypes: a mature boreal production system, a low-forest agricultural adoption system and a degraded restoration system. Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guidance, we consolidated 90 core studies across three country streams and used a targeted set of official and methodological sources to interpret EU-level governance and MRV implications. The review develops a comparative framework structured around forest baseline, land availability, dominant constraints, MRV maturity, carbon-farming pathways and governance mode. The synthesis shows that forest carbon farming should not be treated as a uniform instrument. Production systems require management-change instruments with high-tier MRV and careful treatment of harvest displacement and timber trade-offs. Adoption-constrained systems require low-friction incentives, social legitimacy, biodiversity safeguards and farmer-centred design. Restoration systems require long-horizon stewardship, site-specific ecological feasibility and conservative permanence governance. Across the three archetypes, the environmental challenge is not simply to maximize forest carbon uptake, but to secure additional and durable removals without obscuring trade-offs in timber production, land use, biodiversity, restoration durability and landholder participation. Our synthesis supports a two-layer implementation logic: common integrity criteria at EU level, combined with archetype-specific pathways for baselines, MRV burden, additionality, permanence safeguards and governance. Country-specific implementation should therefore be derived from land-system conditions rather than from administrative borders alone.

title: On the dissipation of energy during rigid blade-tip/abradable coating interactions: A study of AlSi–hBN damage mechanisms activation
summary: Severe blade-tip/abradable contact events—such as those triggered by foreign object ingestion or abrupt rotor displacement—can activate detrimental damage mechanisms (e.g. adhesive transfer, melting, microrupture) that compromise rotor/stat
content: Severe blade-tip/abradable contact events—such as those triggered by foreign object ingestion or abrupt rotor displacement—can activate detrimental damage mechanisms (e.g. adhesive transfer, melting, microrupture) that compromise rotor/stator clearance control and the structural integrity of the bladed disk assembly. Yet the sequence in which these mechanisms are triggered, and the energy levels governing their transitions, remain poorly understood under controlled, single-contact conditions. The purpose of this study is to establish and mechanistically explain this damage activation sequence for an AlSi-hBN abradable coating—a material widely used in the first stages of high-pressure compressors—in order to guide the design of future abradable coatings for high-severity interaction scenarios. Using a linear single-contact interaction rig, tests were conducted between a fixed, rigid Ti6Al4V blade-tip and a moving AlSi-hBN abradable coating specimen at velocities ranging from 100 to 200 m s − 1 and initial coating temperatures from room temperature to 450 °C. The coating thermomechanical response was characterized through specific force coefficients, wear profilometry and high-speed imaging, while post-mortem SEM analyses revealed underlying damage mechanisms at micro- and mesoscopic scales. Four principal wear modes were identified: cutting, adhesive wear, abrasive wear, and microrupture. The transition from adhesive to abrasive wear is observed at 260 °C, which could be attributed to the burnout of the coating’s organic binder. By extension, this assumption is supported by measurements at 450 °C, which show a ∼ 78% drop in the coating’s apparent hardness. An energy-based framework, grounded in the first law of thermodynamics, reveals a sequential damage activation scenario: adhesive cracking at moderate energy levels transitions toward precursory cracking ahead of the contact zone, and ultimately toward microrupture—identified here as a delamination process governed by the anisotropic splat architecture inherent to atmospheric plasma spraying.

title: Unified 4E assessment and multi-objective optimization of modified micro-gas turbines for low-carbon distributed power generation
summary: To accelerate the global transition toward decentralized and sustainable energy systems, micro-gas turbine power plants (micro-GTPPs) have emerged as critical technologies due to their operational flexibility and low emissions. However, the
content: To accelerate the global transition toward decentralized and sustainable energy systems, micro-gas turbine power plants (micro-GTPPs) have emerged as critical technologies due to their operational flexibility and low emissions. However, the deployment of these systems is often hindered by a lack of comprehensive 4E (energy, exergy, economic, and environmental) frameworks that account for the unique thermodynamic and economic constraints of micro-scale configurations. This study addresses this critical research gap by implementing a unified 4E analytical tool to evaluate four micro-GTPP configurations: simple (S-GTPP), regenerative (R-GTPP), intercooled (I-GTPP), and intercooled-regenerative (IR-GTPP). The systems were modelled in Engineering Equation Solver (EES) and validated against literature data with deviations below 2%. A major scientific contribution of this work is the integration of a hybrid multi-objective optimization framework (NSGA-II and TOPSIS) and exergy-based sustainability indicators to identify optimal thermodynamic-economic-environmental trade-offs. Results demonstrate that the IR-GTPP is the superior configuration across key performance metrics, achieving the highest energy and exergy efficiencies (51.35% and 48.45%), the lowest levelized cost of electricity (0.0319 USD/kWh), the lowest payback period (3.898 years), and the lowest specific CO 2 emissions (393 kg/MWh). While the R-GTPP exhibited a higher sustainability index (2.62) due to its lower total exergy destruction, the IR-GTPP offered the most balanced thermodynamic-economic-environmental trade-off, as confirmed by the optimization results. These findings provide precise quantitative benchmarks and design guidance for the development of high-efficiency, sustainable distributed power generation, directly supporting the achievement of UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy) and SDG 13 (Climate Action).

title: Geochemical suitability of recycled clay materials for use in impermeable barriers: laboratory and field-scale leaching assessment
summary: Recycling polluted and remediated excavated soils can enhance resource efficiency and replace the use of finite virgin materials. However, reuse of the fine silt/clay fraction remains limited. This study evaluates the geochemical suitabilit
content: Recycling polluted and remediated excavated soils can enhance resource efficiency and replace the use of finite virgin materials. However, reuse of the fine silt/clay fraction remains limited. This study evaluates the geochemical suitability of two alternative clay materials: soil washing filter cake (SWFC) and excavated cement-stabilized clay (ECSC) for use in constructed impermeable barriers, alongside conventionally used dry crust clay (DCC) for comparison. While the geotechnical performance of these materials has been tested previously, their geochemical characteristics and in-service environmental performance remain insufficiently understood. We investigated the mobility of potentially toxic trace elements using a combination of standard batch leaching test for waste classification (EN 12457-2) and surface leaching test for construction products (EN 16637-2). Laboratory results are complemented with leachate collected from a field final cover pilot barrier constructed from the same materials. Both SWFC and ECSC meet regulatory leaching threshold values for inert waste. According to construction product leaching, SWFC exceeds the emission limit for Sb, whereas ECSC fulfils the requirements. Geochemically, DCC exhibits greater similarity to SWFC than to ECSC. Our data sets revealed relative mobility trends for As, Mo and Sb between laboratory tests and the field pilot. Our results demonstrate that geochemical characterization, complementing geotechnical assessment, is essential for evaluating suitability of recycled fine-grained soils.

title: A review of gaps and opportunities in energy, water, and resource management: From separate parts to a connected system
summary: Achieving sustainability targets amid intensifying global pressures requires a paradigm shift from siloed resource management to a synergistic system reconfiguration. This editorial reviews key contributions from The SDEWES 2024 Virtual Spe
content: Achieving sustainability targets amid intensifying global pressures requires a paradigm shift from siloed resource management to a synergistic system reconfiguration. This editorial reviews key contributions from The SDEWES 2024 Virtual Special Issue, synthesizing findings across the energy-water-resource nexus. Substantial progress has been made in component-level optimization. The component-level advances have not yet been translated into widespread system-level reconfiguration. The limited translation is attributed to the gaps discussed below. Micro-level stakeholder behaviours and cross-sectoral material flow feedback remain excluded from macro-level planning models. A critical gap persists in integrating such elements. Integrated approaches require emphasis in future work. A critical gap persists in integrating behavioural dynamics and cross-sectoral feedback into system-level models, requiring greater emphasis in future research. System reconfiguration is guided by technological improvement and by enhanced coordination across resource systems. System reconfiguration requires technological improvement and enhanced coordination across resource systems. Systemic thinking combined with cross-sector collaboration drives substantial planetary change.

title: Trifluoroacetylacetone-based direct lithium extraction from alkaline brines with trioctylphosphine oxide synergism
summary: The growing demand for lithium as a critical material for battery technologies has intensified the need for selective and efficient direct lithium extraction (DLE) systems capable of processing high-salinity continental brines. This study i
content: The growing demand for lithium as a critical material for battery technologies has intensified the need for selective and efficient direct lithium extraction (DLE) systems capable of processing high-salinity continental brines. This study introduces 1,1,1-Trifluoroacetylacetone (TFAA), a fluorinated β-diketone, as a novel carrier for lithium extraction, and evaluates its synergistic performance in combination with trioctylphosphine oxide (TOPO) dissolved in 1-octanol, a biodegradable, low-toxicity diluent. Systematic optimisation of pH, TFAA concentration, and TFAA: TOPO weight ratio identified pH 12, 3 mmol TFAA, and a 1:5 TFAA:TOPO ratio as optimal conditions, yielding a Li + extraction efficiency of 64.75% and a Li/Na separation factor (β Li/Na ) of 116.17, a 2.4-fold selectivity improvement over the TFAA-only system. Slope analysis revealed a near-unity dependence of log D Li on pH, consistent with the release of one proton per extracted Li + , whereas the non-linear, fractional apparent dependences on TFAA and TOPO concentrations were attributed to the non-tracer conditions and the solvating role of the 1-octanol diluent; FTIR spectral changes were consistent with the participation of the TFAA enolate and the TOPO phosphoryl group in Li + coordination. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations at the M06-2X/def2-TZVP level on a minimal Li–TFAA–TOPO model indicated stronger intrinsic binding of Li + than of Na + and a greater calculated Li + /Na + preference in the presence of TOPO, in qualitative agreement with the experimental selectivity trend. Li + extraction and Li/Na selectivity both increased with increasing NaCl concentration: at a Li:Na molar ratio of 0.1:4, extraction reached 85.05% and βLi/Na rose to 704.43, a trend consistent with increased Li + activity and reduced water activity at high salinity rather than with competition by Na + . Stripping with 0.5 M HCl achieved ~78% stripping efficiency and a single-cycle lithium purity of 91.60%; in a single-run four-stage cross-current sequence, the cumulative extraction increased to 97.05% and the overall recovery to 78.1%, whereas the lithium purity decreased to 63.6%. Over five extraction–stripping cycles without intermediate regeneration, Li + extraction decreased from 64.75% to 41.71%, indicating that a regeneration step will be required for continuous operation. In a synthetic brine simulating Zabuye Lake brine, the system achieved a lithium extraction efficiency of 80.06%, βLi/Na of 325, βLi/K of 401, and impurity removal exceeding 98.99% for Na + and 99.41% for K + , with a total lithium recovery of 60.29% per cycle. These results indicate that the TFAA/TOPO/1-octanol system is a promising candidate for DLE from alkaline continental brines, although total carbon analysis of the raffinate indicated that up to about 20% of the TFAA may be transferred to the aqueous phase per contact, so that minimisation or recovery of carrier losses will be required.

title: Structural drivers of greenhouse gas emissions and decarbonisation pathways across income groups in Asia
summary: This study examines the structural correlates of changes in per-capita greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions across 41 Asian countries from 2000 to 2023, with particular attention to income-group heterogeneity. Two-way fixed-effects models with Dr
content: This study examines the structural correlates of changes in per-capita greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions across 41 Asian countries from 2000 to 2023, with particular attention to income-group heterogeneity. Two-way fixed-effects models with Driscoll–Kraay standard errors evaluate meat production, energy consumption, fertiliser use, urbanisation, trade openness, internet use and mobile cellular subscriptions. The principal analysis applies annual World Bank income classifications, while beginning-of-period and 2024 classifications are used in sensitivity tests. Energy consumption is positively associated with emissions in Asia overall and in the high- and lower-middle-income groups, while trade openness is positively associated with emissions in Asia overall and in the high-income group. High-income economies exhibit a U-shaped relationship between urbanisation and emissions, with an estimated turning point of 82.22%. The relationships involving the two digitalisation indicators differ across income groups. Meat production and fertiliser consumption are not statistically significant in the principal models. The findings are partly sensitive to alternative income classifications, lagged regressors and leave-one-country-out estimation and should therefore be interpreted as conditional associations rather than causal effects. The results support development-stage-specific strategies, including accelerating clean-energy transitions in high-income economies, aligning digital expansion with low-carbon electricity systems in developing economies, promoting greener trade and encouraging resource-efficient agricultural systems. Overall, the study provides income-specific evidence for designing differentiated decarbonisation pathways across Asia.

title: Mechanisms of Deep Coalbed Methane Enrichment in the Daning–Jixian Block, Ordos Basin, China
summary: ABSTRACT Deep coalbed methane (CBM) exploitation plays a vital strategic role in energy transition and energy structure optimization. Field exploration has verified widespread high enrichment of deep CBM in China, whereas its formation mech
content: ABSTRACT Deep coalbed methane (CBM) exploitation plays a vital strategic role in energy transition and energy structure optimization. Field exploration has verified widespread high enrichment of deep CBM in China, whereas its formation mechanism remains poorly understood, which severely restricts commercial extraction efficiency. This study focuses on the Daning–Jixian Block of the Ordos Basin. By comparing structural characteristics, reservoir temperature and pressure between deep and medium‐shallow coal seams, combined with experimental measurements of coal rank, coal composition and pore–fracture spaces, this paper systematically investigates the enrichment mechanism of deep CBM. The results demonstrate prominent east–west geological heterogeneity across the block. Deep seams benefit from tectonic stability, favourable petrophysical properties and well‐developed multi‐scale pore–fracture networks for CBM generation and storage. The coals experienced five distinct tectono‐thermal evolutionary stages. Late differential uplift induced divergent gas preservation. Medium‐shallow seams suffer substantial free gas dissipation and are adsorption‐undersaturated, while deep seams retain abundant free gas and exhibit notable adsorption supersaturation. This research offers new insights into the occurrence of deep CBM and provides a theoretical reference for efficient extraction under complex geological conditions, contributing to the sustainable and secure utilization of unconventional natural gas resources in China.

title: Green reduction synthesis of zinc oxide nanoparticles for the remediation of environmental pollutant dyes
summary: The discharge of toxic dyes from industry sectors such as textiles, paper and leather into water bodies has become a critical environmental concern, as conventional wastewater treatment methods are often ineffective for their removal. The p
content: The discharge of toxic dyes from industry sectors such as textiles, paper and leather into water bodies has become a critical environmental concern, as conventional wastewater treatment methods are often ineffective for their removal. The present work reports the green synthesis, mediated by Triphala Churna, of zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) for the photocatalytic degradation of pollutant dyes, specifically Rhodamine B (Rh-B) and Methylene blue (MB). The NPs were characterized by multiple techniques: UV–Vis spectroscopy to confirm their formation, X-ray diffractometry and transmission electron microscopy combined with selected area electron diffraction and energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy to determine their sizes, morphology, crystal structure, and composition, Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy to identify their surface functional groups, and dynamic light scattering spectroscopy to assess their colloidal stability. Photocatalytic studies demonstrated that the green-synthesized ZnO NPs exhibited superior degradation efficiency compared to traditional chemically synthesized counterparts, achieving faster degradation times for both MB and Rh-B dyes. This enhanced performance is attributed to their relatively small optical band gap energy (2.86 eV), which promotes the generation of hydroxyl (•OH) and superoxide (•O̅2) radicals responsible for oxidative degradation of dye molecules into CO2 and H2O. These findings highlight the potential of GRM-ZnO NPs as suitable photocatalysts for wastewater treatment applications.

title: Polydopamine-mediated dual-anchoring of gelatin hydrogel onto bacterial cellulose membranes for durable antifouling and antibacterial ultrafiltration
summary: Bio-based membranes offer inherent biodegradability and environmental compatibility, but their poor durability remains a major barrier to practical water purification. In this study, we propose a novel bioinspired dual-anchoring interfacial
content: Bio-based membranes offer inherent biodegradability and environmental compatibility, but their poor durability remains a major barrier to practical water purification. In this study, we propose a novel bioinspired dual-anchoring interfacial strategy for stabilizing a gelatin hydrogel as a functional layer on bacterial cellulose (BC) through a polydopamine (PDA) interlayer. The PDA interlayer binds to the BC nanofibers through hydrogen bonding of its catechol and amine groups, while its quinone sites form Schiff base linkages with the gelatin layer, which in turn provides the hydration barrier and the contact-active antibacterial function. The results indicated that the deposition time of the PDA interlayer is decisive. At a polymerization time of 12 h, a uniform PDA interlayer without visible aggregates was formed, which raised the gelatin fixation ratio from approximately 30% to over 90%. However, prolonged deposition (24 h) led to PDA particle aggregation, which increased surface heterogeneity and lowered gelatin retention. The optimized Gel-DA12-BC membrane rejects 88% of BSA at a permeance of 18 LMH bar −1 and sustains a flux recovery ratio of 94% over five filtration-cleaning cycles, and inhibits E. coli growth by approximately 72% without added biocides. These results establish that the durability of the composite is governed by the uniformity of the PDA interlayer rather than by the amount of PDA deposited, and that interfacial anchoring alone provides a fully aqueous, bio-based route to durable ultrafiltration membranes.

title: Synthesis, DFT Studies, and Molecular Docking Evaluation of a Nortopsentin-Inspired Bis-Indole Furazan Derivative Targeting GSK-3Β
source: Black Sea Journal of Engineering and Science
summary: Glycogen synthase kinase-3β (GSK-3β) is a key enzyme involved in various biochemical pathways and is a significant therapeutic target for neurodegenerative and metabolic diseases. In this study, a novel 3,4-bis(2-methyl-1H-indol-3-yl)-1,2,5
content: Glycogen synthase kinase-3β (GSK-3β) is a key enzyme involved in various biochemical pathways and is a significant therapeutic target for neurodegenerative and metabolic diseases. In this study, a novel 3,4-bis(2-methyl-1H-indol-3-yl)-1,2,5-oxadiazole derivative (4c), inspired by the nortopsentin class of marine alkaloids, was designed and synthesized. The target bis-indole furazan derivative (4c) was efficiently synthesized via microwave-assisted cyclization of its bis-indole dioxime precursor (3a) in aqueous NaOH, providing a clean and catalyst-free strategy aligned with green chemistry principles. Structural characterization was achieved by FT-IR, ¹H-NMR, ¹³C-NMR, and elemental analysis and further validated through theoretical spectral calculations. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations provided insights into the molecular geometry, vibrational frequencies, and frontier molecular orbital characteristics of 4c. Molecular docking simulations against GSK-3β (PDB ID: 1Q41) revealed a favorable binding energy (-8.38 kcal/mol) and predicted inhibition constant of 0.725 µM. Computational ADME profiling also revealed acceptable drug-likeness properties. While the present findings are based solely on computational analyses, they indicate that bis-indole furazan derivatives could be considered as potential candidates for future optimization and experimental studies targeting GSK-3β.

title: Environmental physiology
source: The Journal of Physical Fitness and Sports Medicine
summary: Aims] During immersion in carbonated water, CO 2 penetrates the subcutaneous tissue, causing cutaneous vasodilation.In previous measurements, there were instances where no increase in skin blood flow was observed using a laser Doppler flowm
content: Aims] During immersion in carbonated water, CO 2 penetrates the subcutaneous tissue, causing cutaneous vasodilation.In previous measurements, there were instances where no increase in skin blood flow was observed using a laser Doppler flowmeter (LDF), even in situations where cutaneous vasodilation was presumed to be occurring-such as at low water temperatures or low CO 2 concentrations.Therefore, the present study investigated whether it is possible to evaluate skin blood flow during carbonated water immersion using a method other than LDF.[Methods] Twelve participants (M8, F4) were participated in the study.The participants immersed their left forearm in tap water, low CO 2 concentration (500 ppm), or high CO 2 concentration (1000 ppm) carbonated water.Water temperature was increased from 15°C to 30°C during experiment.Skin blood flow was measured by using LDF and microscope (MS), and compared.[Results] In the tap water session, skin blood flow were significantly higher in MS than in LDF.On the other hand, in the high CO 2 concentration session, skin blood flow were significantly higher in LDF than in MS.The rate of change in skin blood flow relative to skin temperature was significantly different in the tap water session (LDF; 1.28±3.42%/°C, MS; 3.30±2.63%/°C).However, there were no significant difference between measurement methods in low and high CO 2 concentration sessions.[Conclusions] Although changes in skin blood flow were evaluated using both measurement methods, the results varied depending on CO 2 concentration and were inconsistent.These differences may be due to variations in the degree of blood flow changes.

title: Intraspecific differentiation in metabolite diversity of a monotypic endemic Indianthus in the Western Ghats
summary: Abstract Indianthus virgatus (Marantaceae), a monotypic genus endemic to the Western Ghats–Sri Lanka Biodiversity Hotspot, represents an evolutionarily distinctive lineage for which intraspecific metabolomic variation remains poorly documen
content: Abstract Indianthus virgatus (Marantaceae), a monotypic genus endemic to the Western Ghats–Sri Lanka Biodiversity Hotspot, represents an evolutionarily distinctive lineage for which intraspecific metabolomic variation remains poorly documented. Such variation can provide insights into biochemical differentiation among populations and potential environmental interactions. We used untargeted high-resolution liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (HR-LC-MS) to characterize metabolomic diversity across nine geographically distinct populations of I. virgatus in the Western Ghats. A total of 3,673 metabolite features were detected, of which 214 putative plant-derived metabolites were annotated and retained for downstream analyses following quality filtering. Multivariate analyses revealed differences in metabolomic profiles among the sampled population composites. Principal component analysis showed that the first two components explained 51.2% of the total variation. Variable importance in projection analysis highlighted glutamyl derivatives, amino acid intermediates, and phenolic compounds as important contributors to the observed separation. Distance-based redundancy analysis identified precipitation during the coldest quarter as the only individually significant environmental predictor ( P < 0.05), although the overall model was not statistically significant ( P > 0.05). KEGG pathway analysis indicated nominal enrichment of pyrimidine metabolism, which did not remain significant after false discovery rate correction (FDR = 0.0539). This preliminary metabolomic characterization provides a biochemical foundation for future multi-omics investigations integrating genomic, transcriptomic, and metabolomic data to elucidate the ecological and evolutionary processes underlying intraspecific diversity in I. virgatus . It also suggests a basis for further research into its phytochemical composition, bioactive compounds, and potential pharmacological applications.

title: Pneumothorax During Laparoscopic Hysterectomy in Steep Trendelenburg Position in a Patient With Morbid Obesity: A Case Report
summary: Pneumothorax is an uncommon but potentially life-threatening complication of laparoscopic surgery. Obesity, carbon dioxide pneumoperitoneum, and the Trendelenburg position can exert synergistic adverse effects on respiratory mechanics and c
content: Pneumothorax is an uncommon but potentially life-threatening complication of laparoscopic surgery. Obesity, carbon dioxide pneumoperitoneum, and the Trendelenburg position can exert synergistic adverse effects on respiratory mechanics and can substantially increase the physiological burden of laparoscopic surgery. We present a case of a 60-year-old female weighing 102 kg, with a BMI of 41.9 kg/m2, with diabetes mellitus, hypertension, and stage IIIB endometrial adenocarcinoma, who underwent laparoscopically assisted total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy under general anesthesia. During steep Trendelenburg positioning, she developed difficulty with mechanical ventilation, hypoxia, and hypercarbia, followed by cardiac arrest. Return of spontaneous circulation was achieved after resuscitation. A subsequent chest radiograph revealed a pneumothorax, requiring intercostal chest drain insertion.
